answers.rationale: Default TxnState::AutoCommit wraps each statement in its own WAL begin/commit cycle that fsyncs on success.

presented_options.A: ARIES-style WAL with explicit undo and redo records plus a separate dirty-page table checkpoint

presented_options.D: an append-only write-ahead log, replayed at startup to re-apply committed transactions and drop the uncommitted suffix

presented_options.D: no per-record check; a single CRC covers the whole WAL file on clean shutdown

answers.rationale: Each WAL record frame carries a CRC32 of its payload; read_all stops at the first record whose CRC fails to verify.

answers.rationale: Each operator implements open/next/close and pulls one row at a time from its child, forming a Volcano-style iterator tree.

answers.rationale: PAGE_SIZE is a single compile-time constant (4096 bytes); pages are not mixed-size — there is no 4 KiB vs 16 KiB choice per table.

presented_options.B: all three rows — every fsynced WAL record is replayed on startup

answers.rationale: committed_records only returns records belonging to transactions that have a COMMIT record; without one, all three inserts are discarded and the SELECT sees no rows.
